messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Caroline Hayes <caroline.hayes@oakmonthealth.org>
Cc: oakmont-procurement@oakmonthealth.org
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: T-shirt estimates for Oakmont on-prem pilot + open uncertainties

Team —

Following our discovery call with Oakmont yesterday, they asked for a scoped on-prem pilot to run Redwood in their VPC (single-region, private connectivity to EHR). Before Sales commits a formal mutual action plan they want a rough engineering/ops estimate and a short list of open unknowns we need to resolve. Can each of you provide a t-shirt / point estimate and the top 3 assumptions that would change that estimate?

What I need by EOD Thursday:
- Eng sizing: rough SWE weeks + infra lead / SRE headcount during pilot + longest critical path (e.g., networking, HSM, airgap).
- Ops constraints: staging footprint, backup/DR expectations, monitoring + runbook effort.
- Product asks: minimal SLA commitments Oakmont expects that would move them to pilot (RPO/RTO, latency P95 targets), and any gating features.

Attach: oakmont_pilot_scope_v0.3.pdf (scope we shared this morning).

This is intentionally early-stage — we don't need formal numbers but want consistent inputs to the sales deck (and to flag holes we can't estimate). I'll consolidate and escalate to Sales/Product if needed.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference

--- attachment: oakmont_pilot_scope_v0.3.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 08 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: T-shirt estimates for Oakmont on-prem pilot + open uncertainties

Stephanie —

High-level engineering view (quick, unreviewed):
- Ballpark: 6 weeks of focused engineering to get an MVP pilot (not GA). Team: ~1.5 SWE FTE (senior infra+serving) + 1 infra lead/architect + part-time PM (0.2 FTE). If we need HSM/KMS integrations or custom quantization toolchain tuning, add ~2–3 weeks and one SWE.
- Hardware: assuming they provide 2x A100-equivalent nodes for pilot; if they need us to size + order, add procurement lead time (6–8 weeks). See hw-sizing.xlsx for sample node counts by expected QPS.

Top unknowns that materially change the estimate:
1) Expected concurrency / QPS at pilot (10 qps vs 200 qps changes node needs drastically).
2) Allowed model variants and quantization level (if they require fp16 and cannot accept int8/4bit, the perf and memory footprint changes).
3) Network topology & egress constraints (if we need private peering-only vs routed NATs, the setup complexity and security review time increases).

Actionable asks for Sales: please confirm the three-year throughput target for the pilot and whether Oakmont will host GPUs or want us to recommend hardware. Also confirm whether they require an HSM-backed key store (Y/N).

I'll attach a small HW worksheet (hw-sizing.xlsx) — numbers assume model family similar to rdx-13b quantized to 4-bit.

-Karthik
Engineering Lead, Serving Runtime

--- attachment: hw-sizing.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: T-shirt estimates for Oakmont on-prem pilot + open uncertainties

Couple of ops points to call out — these will affect the launch window and staffing: 

1) Network & connectivity: we need their network diagram and firewall change window. If they require air-gapped or limited egress, our standard observability (Datadog, traces, metrics export) will require a heavy-lift to proxy/relay metrics to their monitoring or to run a local aggregator. Estimate: +2–3 weeks to integrate local monitoring and create secure export pipelines.

2) Oncall & runbooks: pilot requires 24/7 escalation for first 4 weeks post-launch (typical sales ask). That means ~0.5 FTE SRE rota from our side (oncall overlap agreed with customer) unless they want to absorb first-line triage.

3) Backup/restore and data residency: we need to confirm retention windows, whether logs can be persisted off-host, and whether backups must be encrypted with HSM keys. If HSM is required we'll add integration work and compliance steps (+1 engineer week, +security review).

Op cost note: rough monthly run-rate for the pilot infra (2 GPUs, 2 controller nodes, storage, network egress) ~ $18k–$35k depending on instance sizing and redundancy. This is pre-support and excludes staffing.

I'll drop a short ops risks doc (ops-risks-notes.md) into the Drive folder.

- Grace
Head of Operations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: T-shirt estimates for Oakmont on-prem pilot + open uncertainties

Thanks all — useful starts. Quick product framing:

- Priority: this is sales-driven but we should treat Oakmont as a narrow pilot (not a GA engagement). That means we can accept some manual runbooks and reduced observability for pilot in exchange for speed-to-pilot.
- SLA ask: Oakmont has mentioned "clinical window" latency P95 target ~150ms for inference; can we confirm if that is realistic for their model family and expected QPS? If not, we need to surface acceptable trade-offs.
- Feature gating: we should require (a) audit logging enabled, (b) model pinning/versioning support, and (c) a documented rollback path before pilot go-live.

Decision ask for leadership/product: approve the below go/no-go criteria for Sales to commit to pilot:
1) Oakmont provides QPS estimates and confirms GPU hosting or approves recommended procurement.
2) Security signoff on KMS/HSM or agreed mitigation plan.
3) SRE oncall allocation confirmed (either Oakmont or Redwood takes first-line triage).

Next steps: Stephanie — can you capture these asks in the sales MOU and request the two missing pieces from the customer (QPS target + HSM requirement)? If customer pushes timeline, we should offer a “boxed” hosted-sim environment as fallback while we prep their VPC.

-Marissa
Principal Product Manager
Redwood Inference

Hi Stephanie / team —

Thanks for the breakdown. A few clarifications from our side:
- Pilot target: 30–50 concurrent sessions (bursty), expected steady-state QPS ~25 during business hours.
- GPUs: Oakmont will provision hardware for the pilot (we have a procurement window but can expedite for pilot).
- HSM: we have a HW-backed HSM available and are comfortable with Redwood integrating with our KMS, pending your security questionnaire.

We'll review the MOU draft and get back with exact procurement lead times by EOD Tuesday. Happy to hop on a short call to run through runbook expectations.

Best,
Caroline Hayes
